core_principles: Content is king: Focus entirely on structured data and readability.
Generous Spacing: High signal-to-noise ratio using whitespace.
Clear Status Indication: Functional colors communicate progression.

layout_and_spacing.general: Use max-w-5xl mx-auto for main container. p-6 to p-12 for sections.

roadmap_view.desktop: Flex container with gap-12. Left side (flex-1) for timeline, right side is w-[400px] sticky aside for block details.
roadmap_view.mobile: Single column. Side panel becomes a full-screen Sheet (Shadcn).

vertical_timeline.structure: Relative container with absolute vertical line (w-px bg-slate-200) down the left side (e.g., left-6).
vertical_timeline.node: Flex row, items-start, gap-6 relative z-10. Left item is the status dot/icon placed over the line. Right item is the content card.
vertical_timeline.card: Border-2 rounded-md p-4 transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer bg-white.

components.timeline_card: HTML/Tailwind custom component. Not standard Shadcn Card. Use rigid borders. Dynamic border colors based on status.
components.side_panel: Shadcn Sheet or fixed Sticky sidebar. Contains Block Title, Description, 'Detailed Content' (prose), 'Resources' list, and a sticky bottom section for 'Mark Status' buttons.
components.progress_header: Sticky top bar with Roadmap Title and a Shadcn Progress bar reflecting (completed_blocks / total_blocks) * 100.
components.badges: Shadcn Badge. Flat design (no extreme rounded-full unless for dots).
components.buttons: Shadcn Button. Square or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast.

motion.interactions: Fast and snappy. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Outfit.
Use IBM Plex Sans for body text to give a technical, structured feel.
Implement the vertical timeline using pure Tailwind CSS and pseudo-elements or absolute divs for the connecting lines.
Ensure status changes instantly reflect in the UI by changing the border color and icon of the timeline node (Gray=Not Started, Blue=In Progress, Green=Completed).
Install and use 'lucide-react' or '@phosphor-icons/react' for clean iconography inside timeline nodes.
No AI-slop purple gradients. Stick to the stark, minimal, high-contrast Swiss archetype.
